title: Davis says Puthoff interviewed Brad Sorensen

tellings.quote: cut off, well, Hal Putoff interviewed Brad Sorenson.

plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff is said to have interviewed a man named Brad Sorensen, according to the physicist Eric W. Davis. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb passes this on to Michels from Davis in a single cut-off remark ('Hal Puthoff interviewed Brad Sorensen'), without saying what the interview was about.
